design.null: layer multiset preserved (one head per targeted layer, targets excluded); per-layer pool = the pool_size heads whose THEORETICAL (pre-cast) rank-1 delta norm under d_resid is nearest the targeted head's; sets sampled distinct from the pool product; ACTUAL realized norms recorded per set with realized+theoretical total-norm mismatch vs the targeted set
design.primary_inference: two-sided empirical Monte Carlo p = (1+k)/(n+1); n_sets=24 gives min attainable p = 0.040; sampled from 1296 matched combos, NOT exhaustive
design.direction_control: same four heads; one shared random unit vector per replicate; per-component rank-1 delta scaled to the targeted ACTUAL REALIZED post-bf16 norm (apply_norm_matched_random); each edit's realized norm gated at 3% rel error vs the targeted realized norm; min attainable p = 0.048

norm_match_quality.claim: null sets are norm-SELECTED (nearest-norm pools) but exceed the predeclared total realized-norm tolerance (5%); retain edit norm as a covariate / stratify by norm in any downstream inference

same_head_random_directions.requested_norms: targeted ACTUAL realized post-bf16 delta norms
